# @asharca/ui

> Reusable React controls, forms, workspaces and ToolPlane-style chat components. This repository is an npm package, not a shadcn CLI registry.

## Start here

- [AI usage guide](./docs/ai/README.md): prerequisites, actual import paths, native events and integration boundaries.
- [Composition patterns](./docs/ai/PATTERNS.md): aligned radio/checkbox rows, stable selection and AI chat integration.
- [Package contracts](./package.json): exports, peer versions and scripts are authoritative.
- [Resolved component catalog](./showcase/catalog-data.ts): shared by the site and the Markdown generator.
- [Component metadata](./showcase/component-metadata.ts): main APIs and constraints.
- [Runnable examples](./showcase/demos): complete examples checked against the built public declarations.
- [Repository contributor instructions](./AGENTS.md): instructions for editing this library, not for consuming it.

Run `pnpm docs:ai` with the repository's Node 24 development environment to produce the complete reference.
The built documentation site serves `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and `ai/components/<id>.md` without requiring JavaScript.
The built npm package also contains these references under `dist/ai`.
Unreleased branch APIs may not exist in the npm package bearing the same workspace version; verify before generating code.
